parsed.explanation: Elevated Risk. Known exposures: a documented, police-warned pattern of dating-app ambush robberies and assaults on LGBT people (multiple cases 2023-2024), which a visitor who uses apps is exposed to. Advocates report trans people beaten and stoned, but that is an undenominated claim and gets little weight. Weak recourse: no hate-crime category, no SOGI protection, and parliament has repeatedly refused reform. Section 8 bars entry to non-citizen homosexuals on the books, but no enforcement is documented, and the regional ruling limits its use against bloc nationals. Prison placement is an open question: no trans facility or placement rule exists, and practice is undocumented, so I weigh it lightly but not as safe. Sexuality decriminalisation and the absence of legal gender recognition are tangential or resident-facing and do not move the score much. Trans-specific violence has no denominator, so it is not assessed as a rate.
